name: Accordion
description: Expandable FAQ or feature comparison sections. Each item has a short heading and a hidden body that expands on click. Use for FAQs, expandable feature lists, or any vertically stacked expandable content.
visualSignals: A vertical list of items with chevrons or +/- indicators. Items expand to reveal content. Commonly used for FAQs.

rows.contains: p answer text with optional links (single <td>)

domInput.notes: CRITICAL: Alternating single-cell rows — odd rows (1st, 3rd, 5th…) are the question/trigger text; even rows (2nd, 4th, 6th…) are the expandable answer. Each row has exactly ONE <td>. Do NOT use two cells per row. Use 'seo' variant to generate FAQPage schema markup.
